diagnosis.anchor: A concurrent Bottom/compact PTY logged start/disconnect/release but no at_exit exit marker. The historical exact-command liveness snapshot found no matching live fixture; controlled reaping now distinguishes witness loss from a leak.
diagnosis.cause: Closing stdin and immediately sending TERM can end the Ruby fixture without its at_exit marker. Root reproduced 8 lost markers in 80 exact-baseline trials, with all children reaped and no PID mismatch.
diagnosis.fix: Ignore TERM only in smoke_process; install the real exit hook before the readiness/start marker. EOF remains required for normal completion; production shutdown and strict smoke marker checks are unchanged.

verification.executor: Luna implemented the fixture and regression. Root independently executed red/green, old/fixed process probes, live-marker mutation, basic-mode guard check, full suite and two parallel PTY rounds. Same-lineage reports are correlated support, not independent proof.
